vintage: Curated Philippine Dive Atlas (DOT / Coral Triangle)

sites.name: Tubbataha Reefs
sites.highlights: UNESCO World Heritage atolls; reef & whale sharks, mantas, sheer coral walls.

sites.name: Coron Bay WWII Wrecks
sites.highlights: World-class WWII Japanese fleet wrecks (Irako, Okikawa Maru, Akitsushima) & Barracuda Lake.

sites.name: El Nido / Bacuit Bay
sites.highlights: Limestone-fringed reefs, South Miniloc cabbage corals, Dilumacad tunnel, turtles & macro.

sites.name: Puerto Princesa / Honda Bay
sites.highlights: Sheltered sandbar reefs, lush soft corals, reef fish schools, and seasonal whale sharks.

sites.name: Anilao, Mabini
sites.highlights: World nudibranch & macro photography capital; frogfish, rhinopias, mimic octopus, blackwater.

sites.name: Verde Island Passage
sites.highlights: Center of the Center of Marine Shorefish Biodiversity; dramatic Washing Machine pinnacles & walls.

sites.name: Puerto Galera / Sabang
sites.highlights: 40+ reef, drift, and wreck sites (Canyons, Alma Jane wreck, Hole in the Wall) with rich biodiversity.

sites.name: Apo Reef Natural Park
sites.highlights: World's second-largest contiguous coral reef system; vertical walls, sharks, mantas, eagle rays.

sites.name: Subic Bay Wrecks
sites.highlights: Historic USS New York, El Capitan, and Oryoku Maru wrecks in calm protected bay waters.

sites.name: Ticao Pass / Manta Bowl
sites.highlights: Submerged atoll cleaning station famous for oceanic manta rays, hammerheads, and thresher sharks.

sites.name: Donsol
sites.highlights: Renowned seasonal aggregation of gentle whale sharks (butanding) feeding in plankton-rich waters.

sites.name: Bolinao & Hundred Islands
sites.highlights: Lingayen Gulf coral gardens, giant clam nurseries, and limestone islet drop-offs.

sites.name: Basco & Sabtang Reefs
sites.highlights: Volcanic basalt arches, crystal Luzon Strait visibility, and dramatic underwater topography.

sites.name: Malapascua / Monad Shoal
sites.highlights: The only place on Earth for reliable daily dawn encounters with pelagic thresher sharks.

sites.name: Gato Island Marine Reserve
sites.highlights: Iconic 30 m swim-through cave housing whitetip reef sharks, sea snakes, seahorses & nudibranchs.

sites.name: Moalboal / Pescador Island
sites.highlights: Millions-strong Panagsama sardine run right off the shore plus Pescador Island's sheer coral cathedral.

sites.name: Sumilon Island Sanctuary
sites.highlights: Philippines' first marine protected area (1974); blacktip reef sharks, vibrant walls & drift dives.

sites.name: Apo Island Marine Sanctuary
sites.highlights: Globally celebrated community-run marine reserve; abundant green & hawksbill turtles, huge jack schools.

sites.name: Dauin Marine Sanctuaries
sites.highlights: Premier volcanic-sand muck diving: flamboyant cuttlefish, ghost pipefish, frogfish & blue-ringed octopus.

sites.name: Balicasag Island
sites.highlights: Steep Black Forest & Cathedral walls teeming with sea turtles, barracuda tornadoes & schooling jacks.

sites.name: Cabilao Island
sites.highlights: Quiet Bohol Strait walls rich in pygmy seahorses, gorgonian sea fans, and occasional hammerheads.

sites.name: Siquijor / Paliton Wall
sites.highlights: Healthy uncrowded reefs at Tubod Sanctuary and sheer coral overhangs along Paliton Wall.

sites.name: Boracay / Yapak Wall
sites.highlights: Deep pelagic drop-off with grey reef sharks, eagle rays, tunas, plus Camia wreck & Crocodile Island.

sites.name: Sogod Bay / Padre Burgos
sites.highlights: Pristine Napantao & Limasawa coral walls, rich macro life, and seasonal whale shark visits.

sites.name: Camiguin / Sunken Cemetery
sites.highlights: Coral-encrusted 1871 volcanic Sunken Cemetery, Black Forest giant sea fans & Mantigue Island walls.

sites.name: Siargao / Blue Cathedral
sites.highlights: Dramatic sunlit limestone cavern opening to the Philippine Sea, plus Shark Point & vibrant outer reefs.

sites.name: Samal & Talikud Island
sites.highlights: Giant table corals at Coral Garden, Mansud Wall drop-offs, and protected Davao Gulf wrecks.

sites.name: Sarangani Bay / Lemlunay
sites.highlights: Crystal-clear Celebes Sea walls, WWII wrecks, pygmy seahorses, and frequent dolphin pods.
